title: Segment-list offset
statement: Define the offset of a list of segments at a natural number $i$ recursively: it is $0$ when $i=0$ or when the list is empty; for a nonempty list and positive $i$, it is the rendered length of the first segment plus $2$ plus the offset of the remaining list at $i-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A list of segments is given
